ticker_news.title: Is BigBear.ai Stock a Buy Now?
ticker_news.description: BigBear.ai, a developer of AI-oriented analytics tools, has seen its stock rise about 600% from its all-time low as it stabilized its sales and adjusted EBITDA. The company's growth is expected to be driven by government deals and data-sharing partnerships, but its valuation may not be attractive enough for investors.
ticker_news.author: Leo Sun

ticker_news.title: Palantir Technologies and MicroStrategy Have Been Added to the Nasdaq 100. Are These Stocks About to Soar Even Higher?
ticker_news.description: Palantir Technologies and MicroStrategy have been added to the Nasdaq 100 index, but the author expresses concerns about their high valuations and the volatility associated with MicroStrategy's Bitcoin holdings.
ticker_news.author: David Jagielski

SPY.title: 3 Reasons Vanguard S&P 500 ETF Is a Must-Buy for Long-Term Investors
SPY.description: The article discusses the long-term benefits of investing in the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF, a diversified index fund that tracks the S&P 500 market index. It highlights the fund's low-cost structure, consistent performance, and ability to weather market downturns, making it a recommended choice for long-term investors.
SPY.author: Anders Bylund

SPY.title: US Stocks To Open Higher In The First Trading Session Of 2025: Analyst Says History Favors Rebound After Year-End Dip
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures are expected to open higher on the first trading session of 2025, despite a year-end dip. Analysts believe historical data suggests a rebound is likely after the recent decline.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
